thread:
sam: Noticed a subtle parity issue between REST and Python SDK when calling the batch-embed endpoint from our onboarding sample app. REST false vs SDK 'false' string is causing huge extra cost for demo tenants.

sam: Repro: curl works as expected (no metadata):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"inputs":["a","b"], "include_metadata": false }'
# => returns embeddings only (small response)
```

sam: But Python sample app (requests via SDK) sends: `{"include_metadata": "false"}` and the server treats it as truthy -> populates metadata, runs extra reranker -> payload size & cost balloons.

mina: I dug in: our Python SDK serializer coerces bool-like values via `str(value).lower()` in a util intended for query params and it got reused for JSON body. So booleans become strings.

mina: Sniff from local run:
```
POST /v1/embeddings/batch
Body: { "inputs": ["a","b"], "include_metadata": "false" }
```

rachel: Oof. That explains the surprise billing some demos reported yesterday. CS reported one demo that went from $0.02 -> $4 due to metadata rerun.

infra-bot: Release sdk-python@1.9.2 deployed at 1754124000 (auto-regenerate). Observed quick rollback at 1754124200 for failing demos.

sam: Workarounds: 1) call REST directly with proper JSON 2) monkeypatch serializer in sample app: `client._encoder.encode_bool = lambda b: b` (gross)

mina: I'll open a PR to scope the bool-serializer only to query param builder and fix body encoding to use Python's json.dump defaults. Adding a unit test that dumps booleans and parses them back to bool.

qa-bot: nightly-e2e-1754124500 -> failed (embed-metadata-parity). Attached trace id: tr_0f3e.

rachel: @mina please include a test that runs the onboarding sample app with ephemeral tokens so we catch this in infra pre-merge. Also add a small note in the SDK changelog about behaviour change.

mina: will do. Also checking whether other SDKs share the util; Java/Node look okay but going to add cross-sdk serialization sanity checks.

sam: Can we backport to 1.x? A couple of enterprise pilots pinned to that line.

mina: yep, will prepare patch for 1.9.x branch.

rachel: Support will send out a short customer note and recommend the REST workaround until patch lands. I'll post update to #onboarding when fixed.

sam: thanks team. Adding P1 label to the GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/314 (title: "bool serialization reused util -> body booleans encoded as strings").

infra-bot: CI job ci/56789 rerun queued.

mina: pushed tests + fix in draft PR. Will request review from @rachel and @sam.

sam: :thumbsup: keep updates here so CS can coordinate with affected customers.
